title: Run manifest (00-run.json)
description: Written by intake automation the moment a trigger fires. The root of the audit trail.

actor.description: GitHub login or bot identity that fired the trigger

requestedBy.description: Human on whose behalf a bot acted, when known

workflowRunId.description: GitHub Actions run id, for log traceability

paperclipTaskId.description: Present once the run is dispatched or tracked by a Paperclip task, per the 2026-09-01 Option B decision

prompt.description: The raw request text as received, unedited
